Prepared for the exact Textured6e source and official Blender4.5.13. The original intake at6944344 remains BLOCKED. This diagnostic opens the source once, selects frame0, reads four existing S543_0..3_steering_kingpin meshes and brakes_0003 as an unchanged control, and takes three evaluated snapshots per object. No modifier, geometry, pose transform or material is assigned; there is no save/export/render.

Each snapshot reads UV immediately after to_mesh, again after triangulation/topology reads, and again after actual corner/vertex/polygon normal reads. This distinguishes explicit read ordering from differences between separate to_mesh calls. Evaluated modifiers have already run before the first UV read. Every UV buffer is compared against direct RNA element reads in that same mesh. All arrays are copied before to_mesh_clear.

Full topology includes edge endpoints, loop vertex/edge indices, polygon loop intervals and material indices, triangle vertex/loop/polygon indices. Per-loop comparisons require identical topology and layer identity. Shading observations include actual normals, sharp/seam edges, smooth faces, has_custom_normals and normals_domain. Empty corner-normal coverage stops without manufacturing a normal fallback.

Float32 differences record bit changes separately from finite numeric changes, absolute differences and finite ULP distances, with all changed components mapped to their loop/vertex/edge/polygon identities when applicable. Signed zero has numeric ULP distance0 but remains a bit change. Nonfinite values are explicitly recorded and prevent complete capture. Counts across repeated comparisons/stages are not unique geometric loop counts. Raw mesh fields and selected object/material data are checked before/after; all8518 source object identities and world matrices are protected.

The prior material record identifies MetricUV on the four support parts. Their actual S543_machined_steel graph routes Texture Coordinate.Object to Noise.Vector to Bump.Height to Principled.Normal to the active Surface output; it has no image/UV/attribute/group nodes or connected displacement. This observation does not establish image identity or authorize an exemption from the original guard. The new diagnostic also records the current material graph. No inference about the earlier Master301 hashes is allowed.

Successful capture reports either UV_CHANGE_REPRODUCED_NO_ACCEPTANCE or UV_CHANGE_NOT_REPRODUCED_IN_THIS_RUN. Only a change on a kingpin counts as reproduction of the observed issue; control changes are reported separately. A non-reproduction never rewrites the original failure. Any missing API, changed topology, nonfinite data, raw/protection mismatch or exception remains explicit. No mechanical/visual acceptance is awarded and all16 vehicle gates remainOPEN.

Default run-bounded.py only checks files and hashes. Actual execution requires an explicit shared-computer engine-window record and a new unused output directory. CPU1, child120seconds plus3seconds bounded termination waits; final hash/report I/O is outside that process-control budget. Twelve-second heartbeats preserve progress. Only the owned child handle may be terminated. PID observations cannot establish other tasks' availability. An unconfirmed child exit is never reported as terminal or as a released computation window.

The pure float32 comparator is checked without a native engine. Source helpers are SHA-pinned and only six allowlisted function definitions are extracted from the earlier read-only script; its top-level loader/main is never executed. No binary model, image or GLB is represented as text.

API references: https://docs.blender.org/api/4.5/bpy.types.Mesh.html , https://docs.blender.org/api/4.5/bpy.types.MeshEdge.html , https://docs.blender.org/api/4.5/bpy.types.MeshLoopTriangle.html .
